in_sanskrit.name: Ashfaque
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Follower of the Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashfaque एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashfaque is derived from the Arabic name Ashraf, which means 'Noble' or 'Majestic'. The suffix -que in Ashfaque is derived from the Persian word 'Quli', meaning 'power' or 'strength'. Thus, Ashfaque can be interpreted as 'Noble Power' or 'Majestic Follower of the Moon'.
